decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - Details of a landscaping scheme for the frontage of the plant enclosure facing Forest Road shall be submitted to and shall be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.  The details of landscaping which are approved shall be provided prior to the bringing into use of the plant enclosure and shall be continuously maintained thereafter.  Any trees or other plants which die during the first 5 years of the planting scheme shall be replaced in the next available planting season.

Condition : 3 - With the screening proposed, the development will be in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-P.1.5 (Noise Pollution), ENV-P.1.6 (Air Pollution), and ENV-N.1.4 (Development Near the Green Belt Boundary) of the London Borough of Hounslow adopted Unitary Development Plan (2003), and will not have a harmful effect on the appearance of the existing building, or its setting in the street scene, and will not compromise the open-ness of the Green Belt land opposite.  In addition, no undue noise or air pollution is considered likely to arise. It is, therefore, considered that conditional planning permission should be given.
description: Installation of external plant within fenced enclosures to building 'Smith House 2'.
